about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. New Proofline tasks for the v1.4 and v1.5 milestones in docs/ROADMAP.md. Nothing here is binding and CI does not read this file. The tasks become part of the contract only when the owner merges them into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub.

profiles.normative: The x402 spec, a transport spec or an extension spec says MUST or REQUIRED, and the check quotes it
profiles.security-profile: The spec is silent or permissive, but a public, reproduced failure shows a seller losing money or a buyer paying for nothing
profiles.resilience: Interoperability and recovery under real-world limits and faults

tasks.title: Oracle hardening: strict atomic-unit parsing, fail closed
tasks.description: The reference verifier and every double parse amounts with one strict parser (a JSON string of ASCII digits, no sign, no whitespace, no leading zeros, at most 78 digits) and return invalid_payload or invalid_payment_requirements on anything else, never an exception. A requirement amount must be positive. Spec basis: V2 5.1.2, amount in atomic token units.

criteria.statement: The reference returns a rejection, never an exception, for every malformed payload amount in the table

verifier.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_offline.Offline.test_reference_rejects_malformed_amounts

criteria.statement: The reference rejects malformed, zero and negative requirement amounts

verifier.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_offline.Offline.test_reference_rejects_malformed_requirement_amounts

criteria.statement: A lenient_amounts double (int() parsing) is caught

verifier.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_offline.Offline.test_lenient_amounts_caught

tasks.title: R11 payment-to-request binding on a real resource server
tasks.description: Against a real resource server with two routes at different prices behind the facilitator double: a payment for one route, recipient, asset, network or method never unlocks another; encoded separators and dot segments never reach a paid handler unpaid; and with sign-in-with-x the access record belongs to the route that was priced and settled, not to the client's PaymentPayload.resource.url (upstream x402#3838). Each sub-check has a passing stock control and a faulty build it catches. F10 is narrowed to the requirements a facilitator can enforce.

criteria.statement: R11a: a payment for the cheap route presented on the expensive route gets 402 and no /settle

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-name-pattern='R11a' dist/test/*.test.js

criteria.statement: R11b: an altered payTo, asset or network gets 402 before any /settle

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-name-pattern='R11b' dist/test/*.test.js

criteria.statement: R11c and R11d: method and query substitution are priced for the request actually made

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-name-pattern='R11c|R11d' dist/test/*.test.js

criteria.statement: R11e: encoded separators and dot segments on a parameterised paid route get 402 unpaid

criteria.statement: R11f: a SIWX access record is keyed by the settled route, not the client's resource.url

tasks.title: Normative additions: F5 extended, F11, P6, P7
tasks.description: F5 is extended: a settlement_pending answer carries a non-empty network as well as the transaction (V2 9), with a faulty double that drops them. F11: /verify commits nothing (V2 7.1). P6: the encoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED header is warned above 8 KB and fails above 16 KB (resilience, x402#3803). P7: a 402 whose resolved flow is not authorization declares extra.paymentFlow (V2 6.1).

tasks.title: Concurrency and idempotency: R12, R13, R14
tasks.description: One payment is at most one grant across N parallel requests (R12), across two replicas with and without a shared store (R13), and across a crash between a successful /settle and the response (R14), with a defined, reconcilable outcome. The Lean settlement model is extended to n replicas.

criteria.statement: R12 catches a non-atomic check-then-set under parallel load

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-name-pattern='R12' dist/test/*.test.js

criteria.statement: R13 catches a per-process in-memory cache across two replicas

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-name-pattern='R13' dist/test/*.test.js

criteria.statement: R14 catches a server that settles again after a restart

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-name-pattern='R14' dist/test/*.test.js

criteria.statement: The n-replica theorems build with standard axioms only

tasks.title: Payment versus delivery: R15 to R19
tasks.description: No settlement when the handler fails, redirects or throws (V2 6.1); a paid HEAD is refused before settlement (x402#3810); paid responses don't leak through a cache; settlement_pending and late success end in an explicit, reconcilable outcome; upfront and escrow flows never execute the resource unchecked (V2 6.1).
